decision_conditions:
There is a duty under the planning acts to replace any tree removed if the tree was subject to a Tree Preservation Order (TPO) or growing within a Conservation Area and was removed due to being dead or dangerous, or if the tree has been removed under exemption.  

We would be grateful if you would advise us of your arrangements for replacing the tree to be removed with details of the tree species, size at planting time and intended time of replacement so that we can assess the suitability and timing of the planting.
application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
description:
T1,T2,T3 Eucalyptus, fell to ground level and replace with native more manageable trees, these 3 trees are clustered together in a group x2 trees are showing signs of decay around the base 'honey fungus' all trees are in a location with high people traffic compaction is an obvious issue around an already shallow root system 'target area' all 3 trees are directly next to a active horse stable next to large open space, these trees pose as a risk of failure and given their close proximity to the stables we recommend removal 
T1 before works 10/10m after 0/0
T2 before works 10/10m after 0/0
T3 before works 7m/7m after 0/0

T4 X3 Lime located near arena area to lift to a standing height of 6m thin by 20% and remove all dead wood 
T5 X1 Horse chestnut to lift to a standing height of 6m and the by 20%
T6 Eucalyptus to lift to a standing height of 6m and thin by 20%
